description: This file defines an interface 'StoppedTimer' which extends 'Timer', representing a stopped timer metric object with methods to retrieve its duration, tags, and specific tag values.

classes.name: StoppedTimer
classes.description: An interface representing a timer that has been stopped, allowing access to its duration and associated tags.

methods.name: getDuration
methods.description: Returns the duration of the timer; throws IllegalStateException if the timer hasn't been started and stopped properly.

methods.name: getTags
methods.description: Retrieves all tags associated with this timer.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific tag by its key; may return null if the tag is not present.
